# Defender for Identity - Identity Security Dashboard

Identity posture and activity from **Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting** (Identity* tables), queried live.

> **Data source: Advanced Hunting.** Every panel uses the **Advanced hunting** source against the **CyberSOC** workspace. If a panel shows no data after import, open **Advanced Editor** and confirm **Data source -> Advanced hunting**.

**Layout:** Summary -> Authentication -> Failures / brute force -> Reconnaissance -> Directory changes -> Inventory.

## Capabilities & authoritative sources

This workbook runs on **live Advanced Hunting** (`Identity*`, `Alert*` tables). Some framework pages depend on data that is **not** in hunting tables - sensor health, Identity Secure Score, the recommendations catalog and computed attack paths. For those, use the authoritative Defender pages via the quick links below.

| Framework page | In this workbook | Authoritative source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Landing / Executive** | Partial - activity KPIs (Section 1). Add freshness / coverage % / techniques | this page + link-outs |
| **Coverage & Sensor Health** | KQL **telemetry freshness** only (feasible) | **Defender -> Settings -> Identities -> Sensors** (exact status, CSV export) |
| **Detections & Incidents** | Covered - MDI alerts by kill-chain, severity, trend, top attacked users (Section 7) | Defender **Incidents** (`SecurityIncident`, `ProviderName == "Microsoft XDR"`) |
| **Security Posture & Recommendations** | Link-out (not in AH) | **Secure Score** / **Exposure Management -> Recommendations** (Identities category) |
| **Critical Assets & Exposure Paths** | Covered - sensitive/privileged, dormant, targeted (Section 8). Attack paths = link-out | Defender **Identity inventory** + **Exposure Management -> Attack paths** |
| **Entity / Timeline Investigator** | Not built (single-entity deep dive) | - |

**Quick links (authoritative pages):** [Sensors](https://security.microsoft.com/settings/identities) • [Identity inventory](https://security.microsoft.com/identities) • [Secure Score](https://security.microsoft.com/securescore) • [Recommendations](https://security.microsoft.com/exposure-management/recommendations) • [Attack paths](https://security.microsoft.com/exposure-management/attack-paths)

**Data notes:** Advanced Hunting retains ~30 days, so freshness / dormancy widgets use a 30-day window. Sensor exact state and posture/recommendations require the Defender portal (or a daily sensor-CSV / recommendations snapshot into a custom table). For Tier-0 / expected-DC overlays, use Sentinel **watchlists** (`ExpectedDCs`, `Tier0Assets`, `SensitiveGroups`).

## Executive summary
Identity activity at a glance (last 30 days).

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let L = IdentityLogonEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d);
L | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = "Logon events", Description = "Total logons (30 days)", Sort = 0
| union (L | summarize Value = countif(ActionType == "LogonFailed") | extend Metric = "Failed logons", Description = "Failed authentications (30 days)", Sort = 1)
| union (L | summarize Value = dcount(AccountUpn) | extend Metric = "Active accounts", Description = "Distinct accounts authenticating", Sort = 2)
| union (L | summarize Value = dcountif(AccountUpn, ActionType == "LogonFailed") | extend Metric = "Accounts with failures", Description = "Accounts with at least one failed logon", Sort = 3)
| union (L | summarize Value = dcount(DeviceName) | extend Metric = "Devices", Description = "Distinct source devices", Sort = 4)
| order by Sort asc
| project Metric, Value, Description","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Identity activity (last 30 days)

content.json:
## Authentication, failures & reconnaissance
Logon trend over time, brute-force candidates, and LDAP / SAMR reconnaissance.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"IdentityLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| summarize Successful = countif(ActionType == "LogonSuccess"), Failed = countif(ActionType == "LogonFailed") by bin(Timestamp, 1d)
| order by Timestamp asc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Successful vs failed logons over time

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"IdentityLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d) and ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| summarize FailedLogons = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceName), Locations = dcount(Location) by Account = AccountUpn
| order by FailedLogons desc
| take 15","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Accounts with the most failed logons

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"IdentityQueryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| summarize Queries = count(), Actors = dcount(AccountUpn), Devices = dcount(DeviceName) by QueryType = ActionType
| order by Queries desc
| take 15","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Reconnaissance queries by type

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| summarize Events = count(), Actors = dcount(AccountUpn) by Action = ActionType
| order by Events desc
| take 20","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Directory events by action type

content.json:
## Detections & hunting
MDI alerts by kill-chain, most-attacked users, recon / DCSync, logon anomalies and Kerberos downgrade.

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"AlertInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(30d) and ServiceSource == "Microsoft Defender for Identity"
| summarize Alerts = count() by KillChainStage = Category, Severity
| order by Alerts desc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: MDI alerts by kill-chain stage & severity

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let mdi = AlertInfo | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and ServiceSource == "Microsoft Defender for Identity" | distinct AlertId;
AlertEvidence
| where Timestamp > ago(30d) and EntityType == "User" and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner mdi on AlertId
| summarize Alerts = dcount(AlertId) by AttackedUser = AccountUpn
| order by Alerts desc
| take 10","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Top 5 attacked users

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"IdentityQueryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d) and (ActionType == "SAMR query" or (ActionType == "LDAP query" and QueryType == "AllObjects") or ActionType == "Domain trusts discovery")
| summarize Queries = count() by Actor = AccountUpn, Device = DeviceName, ActionType
| order by Queries desc
| take 20","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Reconnaissance (SAMR / LDAP AllObjects / trust discovery)

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"IdentityLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(8d) and isnotempty(AccountUpn)
| summarize Last24h = countif(Timestamp > ago(1d)), Prior7d = countif(Timestamp <= ago(1d)) by AccountUpn
| extend Avg7d = Prior7d / 7.0
| where Last24h > 5 and Avg7d >= 1 and Last24h > Avg7d * 2
| extend SpikeRatio = round(Last24h / Avg7d, 1)
| project Account = AccountUpn, Last24h, DailyAvgPrior7d = round(Avg7d, 1), SpikeRatio
| order by SpikeRatio desc
| take 5","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Top 5 users with anomalous logon increase

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"IdentityLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d) and Protocol == "Kerberos" and isnotempty(AdditionalFields)
| extend Encryption = tolower(tostring(AdditionalFields.EncryptionType))
| where Encryption contains "rc4" or Encryption contains "des" or Encryption contains "md5" or Encryption contains "export"
| summarize Events = count(), Accounts = dcount(AccountUpn) by Encryption, Device = DeviceName
| order by Events desc
| take 20","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Kerberos encryption downgrade (RC4 / DES)

## Critical assets, honeytokens & cross-domain
Sensitive identities, honeytoken activity, and Entra risky sign-ins for MDI-flagged users.

content.title: Sensitive identities at a glance
Sensitive accounts targeted by MDI alerts
Honeytoken interaction (any = suspicious)

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let mdiUsers = AlertEvidence
| where Timestamp > ago(30d) and EntityType == "User" and isnotempty(AccountObjectId)
| join kind=inner (AlertInfo | where Timestamp > ago(30d) and ServiceSource == "Microsoft Defender for Identity" | distinct AlertId) on AlertId
| distinct AccountObjectId;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(7d) and RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
| where AccountObjectId in (mdiUsers)
| summarize RiskySignIns = count(), Countries = dcount(Country), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by Account = AccountUpn, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by RiskySignIns desc
| take 20","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}
content.title: Entra risky sign-ins by MDI-flagged users
